name: Daimon
tagline: Roppongi in 6 minutes and Tokyo in 10 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 16 minutes to Otemachi, 16 minutes to Shinjuku, 20 minutes to Shibuya and 13 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 3.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 3.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.1 m to 3.2 m, a difference of 2.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 8 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 6 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 港勤労者医療協会芝病院, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 芝公園かみやまクリニック, about 10 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Toei Oedo Line and Toei Asakusa Line. Both lines are run by the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. Toei Asakusa Line runs at 123%. Its busiest stretch is 本所吾妻橋→浅草, which this station is likewise not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥280,000 to ¥290,000 and 2LDK ¥450,000 to ¥460,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. For One room, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Hamamatsucho is ahead on the number of lines and quiet, but Daimon is ahead on how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Daimon. It reaches Otemachi 4 minutes sooner than Daimon.

neighbours.lead: Shibakoen is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and the number of medical facilities, but Daimon is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Daimon. It reaches Otemachi 7 minutes sooner than Daimon.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: 第一京浜 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 6 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
